title: Cheap Card Grading (2026)
verdict: Cheap card grading in 2026 starts at $9 to $12 a card at GMA and $10 at CGC, and AGS is our pick at $15 to $18 because nothing else at that price measures the card and shows you the result.

The cheaper options are real and listed below with their terms. GMA and CGC undercut AGS on low-value bulk. What they do not include at that price is a measured report, subgrades on both sides and freedom from value caps.

why: There is no value upcharge. A $20 card and a $20,000 card cost the same $18 to grade at AGS, and bulk orders of 30 or more start at $15. Subgrades and the report are included, where Beckett charges $3 more for subgrades at its Base tier.
Nothing is locked in. No minimum order, no membership, no contract, and payment is taken when the cards are graded. A first order gets 20% off with code AGSNEW20.

You see why the card got its grade. AGS issues eight subgrades, four for the front and four for the back, plus a defect list and a 3D heightmap. Most graders hand back one number. A buyer who can open the report has less to argue about.

faq.q: How cheap can card grading get?
faq.a: $9 a card at GMA if you send 100 or more, $10 at CGC from 10 cards worth up to $500 each, and $12 at GMA from 25 cards. AGS is $15 from 30 cards and $18 for one.

faq.q: How much does AGS charge to grade a card?
faq.a: $18 per card at the standard rate, whatever the card is worth. Bulk orders of 30 or more TCG cards are $15 each at 20 business days, $20 at 10 or $30 at 5. Sports and non-TCG bulk is $3 more per tier.

faq.q: How many cards count as a bulk order?
faq.a: 30 at AGS. CGC's bulk tier starts at 10 cards, GMA's economy tier at 25, and GMA drops its price again at 100.

faq.q: Do graders charge more for valuable cards?
faq.a: Several do. PSA and SGC price by declared value, and CGC caps each tier by card value and moves a card up if it is worth more. AGS, Beckett, TAG and ISA say they add no upcharge for value.

faq.q: Is there a minimum number of cards?
faq.a: Not at AGS. You can send one card at $18, and bulk pricing needs 30. CGC's bulk tier needs 10 cards, ISA needs 10, and GMA needs 10 to 25 depending on the tier.
